title: Coupled-scale calibration service and runtime fallback flow for INT8/FP8
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build a reusable calibration service that produces coupled activation/weight scale profiles (per-layer, per-channel candidate sets) plus a small fingerprint for each profile so the runtime can detect drift and choose a safe kernel path. The service will support: offline batch calibration using representative corpora, streaming calibration that aggregates live traffic summaries, and a verification harness that automatically evaluates candidate profiles on a defined prompt suite. The runtime integration will extend the kernel selector to: 1) prefer INT8 kernels when the profile fingerprint matches historical signals and accuracy regression is below threshold; 2) fall back to FP16/FP8 mixed kernels when drift or high-latency conditions are detected. This ticket covers the service API, calibration job orchestration, validation metrics, runtime contract changes, and the graceful fallback policy implementation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Calibration service can ingest a corpus and emit a profile bundle: per-layer scales, per-channel candidates, and a stable profile fingerprint. 2) Verification harness runs automatically and produces delta metrics (lm-perplexity, top-k token divergence, embedding cosine vs baseline) and flags profiles that exceed rollback thresholds. 3) Runtime kernel selector accepts profile bundles and uses fingerprint to select INT8 kernels; if the runtime detects >X% accuracy drift or >Y ms tail latency for 10s of requests, it switches to fallback policy. 4) End-to-end canary rollout to dedicated capacity succeeds with no customer-facing regressions on the QA prompt suite and meets latency SLOs. 5) Observability (dashboard + alerts) surfaces per-profile accuracy deltas and fallback counts.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for scale computation and profile fingerprint invariants.
- Offline calibration job test with synthetic corpora (small/mid/large).
- Verification harness runs: compare baseline FP16 -> INT8 profile deltas; assert embedding cosine >= 0.995 and next-token KL <= 0.02 for P0 scenarios.
- Integration test: runtime kernel selector in a staging cluster consumes profile bundles and triggers fallback on injected drift.
- Canary: 5% traffic on dedicated pool for 48h with detailed traces.
- Post-mortem checklist available in Confluence for any rollback.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge calibration service (feature-flagged) and verification harness behind feature flags. 2) Deploy to staging, run full verification against production-like dataset. 3) Canary to a single dedicated capacity pool with feature flag enabled for a single customer namespace. 4) Monitor accuracy and latency dashboards for 72h; if any regression above thresholds is observed, trigger automatic rollback to FP16 path and open incident. 5) Gradual ramp to 25% then 100% once stability is confirmed.
notes: Kernel selector change proposal: add 'profile_fingerprint' field to runtime manifest and allow per-profile soft-preferences for kernel families
Calibration dataset candidates: common_corpora_v2 (crypto/developer/docs/dialogue/sample1), need sign-off from PM
